episodes.title: Gooning: How Chronically Online Culture can Become a Cult, Sometimes | Science Slam by Josh Felix
episodes.description:
This presentation was part of the Edinburgh Science Slam 2026, a two-evening event planned and executed by Talk Science, the University of Edinburgh's Science Communication Society. Event idea and lead: Luca Neuperti.

If this presentation has left you curious, feel free to reach out to Josh Felix via LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/josh-felix-a0260733a/
